title: Free Resume Builder for Beginners: Create a Professional Tech Resume with Zero Experience
description: How beginner developers and career switchers can build a professional, ATS-ready resume highlighting projects, certifications, and technical skills.
body:
Transitioning into software engineering from a non-traditional background or building your very first tech resume can feel overwhelming. The key to landing initial recruiter interviews is positioning your practical coding projects and technical certifications at the forefront.

## 1. How to Structure a Beginner Developer Resume

- Lead with Technical Skills: Show the exact languages and frameworks you've mastered (e.g., JavaScript, Python, React, PostgreSQL).
- Put Projects Above Work Experience: If your past experience is non-technical, dedicate 60% of your resume page to 3-4 robust software projects.
- Emphasize Live Demonstrations: Provide working deployment links (Vercel/Netlify) and clean GitHub source repositories.

## 2. Build Your Free Beginner Resume Today

InternFlow's free AI Resume Builder guides you through entering your skills, writing quantifiable bullet points, and exporting a clean, professional 1-page PDF.

faq.q: Should I include online certificates (Coursera, Udemy) on my resume?
faq.a: Yes! Group recognized certifications under an 'Education & Certifications' section to prove disciplined continuous learning.
